Design and methodology: Each round of calls will be evaluated and verified before the next annual cycle is 
launched, collaborate with KMS focal points on research proposal writing training. Main steps of implementation 
will include: (1) Rounds of discussions with each regional office; (2) internal TDR prioritization of RCS and research 
priorities in each region; (3) request and review priorities list from each regional office; (4) Joint discussion and 
agreement on synergetic areas of interest to TDR and each regional office; (5) development and review of the call 
for proposals; (6) issue and disseminate calls for proposals through TDR and re gional office networks; (7) screening 
and selection of the proposals; (8) funding and implementation of projects; (9) monitoring and reporting; and (10) 
results translation, publication and dissemination.
